craft-panel-element.title: Element Material Config
craft-panel-element.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this element? This will not remove already configured element components.
craft-panel-element.showClass-hint: Only elements matching these classes are shown in the left element area. Separate with commas. Leave empty to show all elements.
craft-panel-element.requirements-hint: Only items meeting the requirements are shown in the right material area (you can still drag items from elsewhere into the center config area).
craft-panel-element.requirements-folder-hint: Requirement is met when an item's folder name matches an entry here. Separate with commas. Highest priority.
craft-panel-element.requirements-type-hint: Requirement is met when an item type contains an entry here. Lowest priority.
craft-panel-element.requirements-script-hint: The script must return a Boolean value. If true, the requirement is met. You can reference the item variable (the item being checked).
craft-panel-element.shape-alter-hint: If preset shape options are not enough, set a Font Awesome icon text from fontawesome.com. Only fa-solid is supported, and remove the prefix fa-solid fa-. For example, for , set this to "burger-cheese".

craft-panel-recipe.title: Configure Recipe
craft-panel-recipe.edit-num-info: If only Use Min is enabled, the recipe only checks whether components reach the minimum value (default behavior). If only Use Max is enabled, components above the maximum are invalid, usually to forbid certain materials/elements. If both are enabled, quantities must stay within the range.
craft-panel-recipe.show-result-hint: If set to No, the recipe result will not be shown in the description on hover.
craft-panel-recipe.is-locked-hint: Locked recipes are hidden and cannot be crafted even if materials match.
craft-panel-recipe.craft-as-handler-hint: If set to Yes or No, this overrides the panel-level Create as Handler option. If set to Default, it uses the panel setting.
craft-panel-recipe.handler-template-hint: This handler template overrides the one configured in the craft panel.
craft-panel-recipe.craft-script-hint: Script executed when crafting. Available variables: data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,recipe,results,canceled.
craft-panel-recipe.unlock-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean or string: false blocks crafting even if materials match, unlock means unlocked but hidden, show means unlocked and visible. Available variables: actor,recipe,panel.

craft-panel-modifier.title: Configure Modifier
craft-panel-modifier.edit-num-info: If only Use Min is enabled, the modifier only checks whether components reach the minimum value (default behavior). If only Use Max is enabled, components above the maximum are invalid, usually to forbid certain materials/elements. If both are enabled, quantities must stay within the range.
craft-panel-modifier.auto-apply-hint: If checked, this modifier is auto-selected when conditions are met and cannot be removed.
craft-panel-modifier.as-ae-hint: Create this modifier as an Active Effect on the result instead of directly editing item data. Merge combines with other merge modifiers using the item's own name/icon. Separate creates its own Active Effect using the modifier's name/icon.
craft-panel-modifier.ae-name-hint: Used only when As Active Effect is set to Separate.
craft-panel-modifier.ae-type-hint: Used only when As Active Effect is set to Separate or Merge.
craft-panel-modifier.is-locked-hint: Locked modifiers cannot be selected even if material requirements are met.
craft-panel-modifier.craft-script-hint: Script executed when crafting. Available variables: data,panel,actor,modifiers,elements,materials,modifier,results,canceled.
craft-panel-modifier.unlock-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean or string: false means cannot be selected even if requirements are met, unlock means unlocked but still requires other conditions, true means selectable regardless of other conditions. Available variables: actor,modifier,panel.

craft-panel-cook-recipe.title: Select Cooking Recipe
craft-panel-cook-recipe.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this recipe?

craft-panel-handler.title: Handler Panel
craft-panel-handler.parallel-limit-hint: Maximum number of unfinished handler objects each actor can have simultaneously. 0 means unlimited.
craft-panel-handler.empty-actors-default: No actors to display. Please configure actor filters first.
craft-panel-handler.empty-templates-default: No handler templates yet. Please create one first.
craft-panel-handler.actor-requirements-hint: When enabled, actors are filtered independently by each method, then merged and deduplicated for display in the left column.
craft-panel-handler.actor-requirements-name-hint: Match actors in game.actors with exactly the same name.
craft-panel-handler.actor-requirements-uuid-hint: Configure multiple UUIDs. Each is resolved with fromUuid.
craft-panel-handler.actor-requirements-script-hint: Only takes effect when the script returns an Actor or an Actor array. Other return values are ignored. Available variables: data,panel,user.
craft-panel-handler.actor-requirements-player-character-hint: When enabled, collects character from all non-GM users.
craft-panel-handler.handler-script-hint: Script executed when the Complete button is clicked on a handler object and settlement succeeds. Available variables: data,panel,handler,actor,user.
craft-panel-handler.tags-hint: Tags can be shown in titles and edited by players for custom marking or grouping. Separate with commas.
craft-panel-handler.categories-hint: Categories are used to classify handler objects and can be filtered in the UI.
craft-panel-handler.audio-progress-handler-hint: Played when advancing progress, rolling, or manually marking a step.
craft-panel-handler.audio-complete-handler-hint: Played when clicking Complete and settlement succeeds.
craft-panel-handler.audio-delete-handler-hint: Played when deleting a handler object or handler template.

craft-panel-blend.title: Blend Panel
craft-panel-blend.merge-by-name-hint: If checked, crafted results merge with items of the same name. Otherwise a new item is always created.
craft-panel-blend.unlock-recipe-hint: If checked, the recipe is unlocked for that player to view after the first successful craft. This only affects visibility and does not change locked state.
craft-panel-blend.show-result-hint: Not Show never displays results. Show displays results, but shows a question mark if multiple outcomes exist. Question Mark shows ? when there is any result, otherwise hides. By Unlock shows result after unlock; otherwise shows ?.

craft-panel-forge.title: Forge Panel
craft-panel-forge.delete-confirm-info: Are you sure you want to delete this craft result? New craft results will not inherit previous modifications.
craft-panel-forge.result-limit-hint: When multiple craft results are configured, set how many can be selected. 0 means unlimited.
craft-panel-forge.modifier-limit-hint: Maximum number of modifiers selectable per craft. 0 means unlimited.
craft-panel-forge.base-cost-hint: Points available for selecting modifiers. Base cost is available even when there is no element quantity.
craft-panel-forge.cost-element-hint: Set the element id here. If set, available points are increased by this element quantity.
craft-panel-forge.cost-script-hint: Executed initially and each time materials are placed. Script must return a number to override final available points. Available variables: data,panel,actor,modifiers,elements,materials,baseCost,elementCost,cost.
craft-panel-forge.auto-quantity-hint: If checked, result quantity is auto-adjusted by material weight: material weight divided by configured weight value, rounded down, minimum 1. Not recommended for roll table results.
craft-panel-forge.auto-weight-hint: If checked, result weight is auto-adjusted by material quantity: material weight divided by configured result quantity value. Not recommended for roll table results, and not recommended together with Auto Quantity.
craft-panel-forge.origin-weight-hint: If checked, this result uses the item's original weight instead of Auto Weight or fixed configured weight.

craft-panel.title: Craft Panel
craft-panel.is-necessary-hint: If checked, this slot must be filled before crafting
craft-panel.is-consumed-hint: If checked, materials in this slot are consumed when crafting
craft-panel.is-locked-hint: If locked, this slot cannot be filled
craft-panel.unlock-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean. If true, this slot is unlocked. Available variables: data,panel,actor,elements,materials.
craft-panel.slot-script-hint: Script must return an object shaped as {isNecessary: boolean, isConsumed: boolean}. If isNecessary is true the slot becomes required, false makes it optional. If isConsumed is true the slot consumes material, false means it does not. Available variables: data,panel,actor,elements,materials,slotItem.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-hint: Only items meeting requirements can be placed into this slot
craft-panel.slot-requirements-name-hint: Requirement is met when item name matches an entry here. Highest priority.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-type-hint: Requirement is met when item type contains an entry here. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.slot-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean. If true, the requirement is met. You can reference the item variable.
craft-panel.panel-requirements-hint: Only items meeting requirements are shown in the right material area (you can still drag items from elsewhere into slots)
craft-panel.panel-requirements-name-hint: Requirement is met when item name matches an entry here. Highest priority.
craft-panel.panel-requirements-type-hint: Requirement is met when item type contains an entry here. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.panel-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean. If true, the requirement is met. You can reference the item variable.
craft-panel.category-requirements-hint: Only items meeting requirements are shown by this category filter in the right material area
craft-panel.category-requirements-name-hint: Requirement is met when item name matches an entry here. Highest priority.
craft-panel.category-requirements-type-hint: Requirement is met when item type contains an entry here. Lowest priority.
craft-panel.category-requirements-script-hint: Script must return a Boolean. If true, the requirement is met. You can reference the item variable.
craft-panel.limit-num-hint: If set, this category can select at most this many modifiers. 0 means unlimited.
craft-panel.craft-pre-script-hint: Script executed before crafting starts. Available variables: data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,canceled.
craft-panel.craft-post-script-hint: Script executed after crafting completes. Available variables: data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,recipe,results,canceled.
craft-panel.craft-script-hint: Script executed during crafting after results are determined but before items are created. Available variables: data,panel,actor,recipes,elements,materials,recipe,results,canceled.
craft-panel.refresh-script-hint: Script executed when the UI updates (for example when placing/removing materials). Available variables: data,panel,actor,elements,materials.
craft-panel.craft-as-handler-hint: If checked, clicking Craft will not directly create items. Instead, craft results are created as a new handler object in the Handler Panel. Requires a handler template.
craft-panel.handler-template-hint: When Create as Handler is enabled, select the template used to create the handler object. Its configured steps, etc. will apply.
craft-panel.override-handler-name-hint: When enabled, new handler objects use current craft panel name + result name; when disabled, use handler template name.
craft-panel.override-handler-icon-hint: When enabled, new handler objects use result icon; when disabled, use handler template icon.
craft-panel.owner-check-hint: Script must return a Boolean to decide whether to block crafting when input materials have no owner. If script returns false, an error is shown and crafting is blocked. Available variables: data,panel,item,actor.
craft-panel.position-unlock-hint: If checked, slots use absolute positioning and can be dragged/configured via X/Y values. Otherwise relative positioning is used with automatic layout.
craft-panel.keep-materials-tooltip: Automatically refill with the same materials after crafting
craft-panel.ingredient-limit-hint: If set, the same-named material can fill at most this many slots. 0 means unlimited.
craft-panel.hide-quantity-hint: Configure whether quantity is hidden for this slot. Default depends on material state: if slot binds a specific item, or material allows multi-quantity per slot, quantity is shown; otherwise hidden. Yes always hides, No always shows.
craft-panel.bind-item-hint: Configure the bound item name. If set, the slot auto-fills that named item and shows total quantity, and those items are hidden from the right material list. Only when no such item is found will the slot be empty with quantity 0. Ensure items with that name are consistent.
craft-panel.bind-item-quantity-hint: Only effective when Bind Item is enabled and this slot is set to Consumed. Configure how many bound items are consumed when crafting. Slot shows total/consumed, e.g. 3/2 means 3 available and 2 consumed. 0 means consume all.
craft-panel.bind-item-element-by-quantity: Bound Item Adds Element by Quantity
craft-panel.bind-item-element-by-quantity-hint: Only effective when Bind Item is enabled. Whether bound item quantity increases elements. Requires Per Quantity setting.
craft-panel.bind-item-element-per-quantity-hint: Only effective when Bind Item is enabled. Configure element multiplier per bound item quantity. For example, 0.5 with 4 consumed bound items adds 2x elements. Requires Add Element by Quantity.
craft-panel.audio-volume-hint: Volume percentage for sound effects, default 100, range 0-100. Final volume is also affected by Foundry's own volume settings.
craft-panel.audio-craft-canceled-hint: Played when crafting is canceled during settlement. Requires custom script: in some stage of craft script (except post-craft script), set data.canceled to true. Note this is not a failure roll sound.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-multi-quantity-hint: If checked, allow multiple same-named materials in one slot and show total quantity. Otherwise one same-named material per slot.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-min-hint: If set, requires at least this quantity of same-named material. 0 means no requirement.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-max-hint: If set, allows at most this quantity of same-named material. 0 means no requirement.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-element-by-quantity-: If checked, element value can scale by quantity of same-named material. Requires Per Quantity setting.
craft-panel.ingredient-settings-element-per-quantity: Configure element multiplier per same-named material inserted. For example, 0.5 with 4 materials adds 2x elements.

edit-element-config.title: Edit Element
edit-element-config.ids-hint: Display element IDs. Use commas in configuration to support multiple elements.
edit-element-config.name: Name
edit-element-config.name-hint: Default name displayed when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.img-hint: Default icon displayed when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.color-hint: Default color displayed when quantity is 0.
edit-element-config.use-min-hint: If checked, element quantity will not go below Min.
edit-element-config.value-hint: Value per point of element, used only as reference for sorting when calculating element quantity in the right material panel. Unset value is 0.
edit-element-config.min-hint: Minimum element value. If Use Min is checked, element quantity will not go below this value.
edit-element-config.use-max-hint: If checked, element quantity will not exceed Max.
edit-element-config.max-hint: Maximum element value. If Use Max is checked, element quantity will not exceed this value.
edit-element-config.multi-show-hint: How icon and name are displayed when multiple element IDs are configured
edit-element-config.multi-show-default: Show only default name and icon
edit-element-config.multi-show-max: Show name and icon of the highest quantity element
edit-element-config.multi-show-min: Show name and icon of the lowest quantity element
edit-element-config.multi-value-hint: How values are calculated when multiple element IDs are configured
edit-element-config.multi-value-all: Use all included elements and show summed quantity
edit-element-config.multi-value-only-max: Use only the element with highest quantity
edit-element-config.multi-value-only-min: Use only the element with lowest quantity
edit-element-config.multi-value-max-plus: Choose highest quantity element, then add other elements to it
edit-element-config.multi-value-min-plus: Choose lowest quantity element, then add other elements to it
edit-element-config.multi-value-max-minus: Choose highest quantity element, then subtract other elements from it
edit-element-config.multi-value-min-minus: Choose lowest quantity element, then subtract other elements from it
edit-element-config.plus-elements-hint: Configure element IDs (comma-separated). After multi-value processing, if original value is not 0, these element quantities are added to final result. Useful for universal-element-like behavior.
edit-element-config.minus-elements-hint: Configure element IDs (comma-separated). After multi-value processing, if original value is not 0, these element quantities are subtracted from final result.

notification.must-fill-necessary-slot: All required slots must be filled
notification.must-choose-at-least-one-result: At least one result must be selected
notification.must-fill-at-least-one-result: At least one result slot must be filled
notification.script-error: Your script has an error. Please check the console (F12) for details
notification.tableItemNotFound: Item not found in roll table
notification.updating: craftpanel is updating settings due to changes in the new version...

settings.quantityPath-hint: Path to item quantity data (starting from 'system'. For example, if quantity is stored in item.system.itemQuantity.value, set 'system.itemQuantity.value').
settings.weightPath-hint: Path to item weight data (starting from 'system'. For example, if weight is stored in item.system.itemWeight.value, set 'system.itemWeight.value'). This setting is only used by cooking panel auto-quantity.
settings.descriptionPath-hint: Path to item description data (starting from 'system'. For example, if description is stored in item.system.text, set 'system.text').
settings.defaultAEType-hint: Default Active Effect type used when a modifier is created as an Active Effect.
settings.debug-hint: Whether to enable debug mode. Debug logs are printed to console only when enabled.
settings.customItemColorScript-hint: Input JavaScript code with item as argument and return a color string. Example: return item.type === 'weapon' ? '#ff0000' : '#00ff00';
